rows.en: What!?
Hoi! They've broken into the archive room!
Hoi! They're closing in on the powder magazine!
Blast it, there's no choice! Jettison the archive room and escape!
Damn… The Navaron cut loose this archive room and got away!

…!?

What's this!?
It's the Navaron's blueprints!
No good… Going by these blueprints, I can't even tell where the command room is.
Looks like every part of it can be detached however they like, huh?
So no matter how much we attack it, we can't deal it a decisive blow?
Somehow… it looks like nothin' but a rough draft of a blueprint, eh?

Too bad…

I thought this would let us finally take down the Navaron!
It's too early to give up! This may be a concealed design…
A concealed design?
That's right! The key parts are hidden in advance, so it's safe even if someone spies on it.
Kaijo… what if we hold it over a fire? Reckon somethin'll show up?
Oh… It might come out with a surprisingly simple trick! Peggy!
Okay!
Well?
Nothing…
Don't give up! There must be some way…
Nngh… Volcano Mask, you have lost!
Your Excellency! Give me one more chance! This time, I swear…
Now that the blueprints are in enemy hands… the Navaron has lost its value as a fortress! You have lost!

Your Excellency…! Please wait, please wait!

Those blueprints have a special trick built into them! A quick look shouldn't reveal the Navaron's secrets…

Your Excellency…!

Everyone, listen well! We now challenge the Gorenger to a decisive battle!

There will be no retreat! We advance until we win! Understood?
Hoiii!
Right… Navaron, charge!

The Navaron is advancing while destroying the EAGLE branches in each district!

They've decided to go all out before we can decode the blueprints, haven't they?

Commander… At this rate, EAGLE will be wiped out!

Let us sortie the Varidreen…
No… It has a barrier against attacks from the air.
What about the Varitank? From underground again…
The enemy's not stupid… Do you think the same trick will work twice?
Then… you're telling us to just sit tight like this?
What we must do is decode those blueprints as quickly as possible!
Fiiire! Fire away! Lost your nerve, Gorenger? Fire! Destroooy!
Following EAGLE Branch 25, the 26th Kanto Branch has also been destroyed…
Damn that Volcano Mask…
Commander… The TDF Security Squad has gone out to intercept!

Mm… I hope they can buy us some time…

All right… run it through the decoder one more time!
So that's the mobile fortress Navaron?

Listen up! Don't even think about destroying that mobile fortress!

It's enough for us if we can keep the damage from its attacks to a minimum!

At present… we have no idea at all how to destroy that mobile fortress!

But… this is EAGLE, the International Defense Organization we're talking about! They're sure to solve the blueprint's riddle and find a way to beat it!

Hold out until then! Understood? All units, commence attack!

What's wrong? Isn't it any good!? Today's curry?

Maybe it really does need to sit overnight…
It's this blueprint…
A blueprint?
I just can't figure it out… the riddle of this blueprint!
It looks like an ordinary blueprint… Is there some kind of trick to it?

If even EAGLE's decoder can't make anything of it… then we're stumped, huh?

There we go… [HERO4], you take yours black, right?
Ah, thank you…
Kyah!
Are you all right!? Did you burn yourself!?

Yes! I'm an organic droid, after all…

But I'm so sorry! Spilling the coffee like that…

…!?

What's this…!?
It kinda looks like a doodle… Is it really a blueprint?

If even EAGLE's decoder can't make anything of it… then we're stumped, huh?

There we go… [HERO4], just milk for you, right?
Yeah, thanks…

Whoa, close one… It almost left a stain!

Sorry! I spilled the coffee… What a waste, huh?
Commander… We ran it through the decoder, but there was no reaction…
I see… So it was just an ordinary blueprint after all?

Ngh… Why won't you come out, Gorenger!?

Very well… If you won't come out, I'll come to you!

Navaron, begin submerging!
The Navaron has gone underground!
Commander! The Navaron intends to search out this base from underground!
It's showin'!
What is it, Dai? Did you see a ghost or something, at a time like this?
The blueprint! When I poured coffee on it, it showed up!
What!? Coffee made it show up?
The command room, the power room… and this is the weapons depot.
If we blow up these three rooms at the same time, we can take down the Navaron!
But, Commander… even the Varitank can't blow up three places at once.
We'll use the three Star Machines! The machines can find their target rooms and smash their way in!
Kaijo, let's do it!
Commander, we'll do it!
But… the Navaron is underground! How will we get the machines to it?
We lure it up to the surface… Ki and Momo, sortie in the Varitank!
We're going underground!
You got it!
Gyro Screw, switch on!
Ah, it's the Varitank! It's coming at us underground!
We surface once, jump over the Varitank and dive again! Then we attack it from behind.

uncertain: U10911/U10916/U10944/U10946/U10964/U10966: Daita Oiwa's Kyushu dialect rendered as folksy casual speech.
U10915: 汰せて read as 伏せて "hidden".
U10947-U10957: two [HERO4] variants (polite and casual); the coffee spill reveals the hidden blueprint. U10950 and U10953 are narration-kind continuations.
U10952: 官機ドロイド unclear; read as 有機ドロイド "organic droid" (she isn't burned). Please verify.
U10956/U10957: lines end without a closing bracket in the Japanese.
U10975: キとモモ = Kirenger and Momorenger, kept as the nicknames "Ki and Momo".
